column7: A restricted PAT (project, environment, permission or CIDR restriction) could make every ungated self-service write on main: no permission gate covers them, so Authorize and the ADR-042 restriction never saw them. Red on main for 22 of the 23 refused routes, every restricted persona of the PAT-GUARD-1 fixture (2 owners x 5 restrictions): e.g. PUT /api/v1/auth/profile 200 'Profile updated', POST /auth/change-password 200 (the first persona's change then logged out the rest); POST /auth/tokens was already refused (#3062). Fixed per Andrei's decision of 2026-10-11 (ADR-042 addendum, deny-by-default): core.restrictedPATUngatedWrites declares every ungated write refused or allowed with a reason, and RefuseRestrictedPATUngatedWrites on /api/v1 answers 403 + the sentinel. Family-wide: the route set is derived from router.go's AST (scanRouter), an undeclared ungated write or a stale entry fails (watched red by deleting the PUT /auth/profile entry), and allowed entries are checked to really succeed.
